findings.title: Denial cache test sets cached permission to false instead of true
findings.body: In `TestService_CacheCheck` ("Should deny on explicit cache deny entry"), the test intends to seed `permCache` with an allow entry to verify that `permDenialCache` short-circuits the check. However, it sets `map[string]bool{"dashboards:uid:dash1": false}` instead of `true`. Because `checkPermission` checks `if scopeMap[t.scope(req.Name)]`, a `false` value denies access anyway (and the backing `fakeStore` has no permissions either), so this test would pass even if `permDenialCache` were never consulted.
